stable.notes: Fixes the tall blank column 0.5.155's mission rows could open inside the live-session list: the state rail was a bare shape that stretched to any offered height, so one running row could absorb hundreds of points of empty card. The rail now rides as an overlay that takes exactly the row's own height — rows are as tall as what they say, nothing more. Everything else in 0.5.155 is unchanged. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
